title: Tag
whenToUse:
- It can be used to tag by dimension or property.

- When categorizing.

examples.name: Basic
examples.description: Usage of basic Tag, and it could be closable and customize close button by set `closeIcon` property, will display default close button when `closeIcon` is setting to `true`. Closable Tag supports `onClose` events.

examples.name: Colorful Tag
examples.description: We preset a series of colorful tag styles for use in different situations. You can also set it to a hex color string for custom color.

examples.name: Add & Remove Dynamically
examples.description: Generating a set of Tags by array, you can add and remove dynamically.

examples.name: Checkable
examples.description: `CheckableTag` works like Checkbox, click it to toggle checked state. `CheckableTagGroup` provides function that is similar to `CheckboxGroup` or `RadioGroup`.

examples.name: Animate
examples.description: Animating the Tag by using motion.

examples.name: Icon
examples.description: You can add a custom icon to the tag via the `icon` prop. Note that the `icon` prop for CheckableTag is only supported in version `>=5.27.0`.

examples.name: Status Tag
examples.description: We preset five different colors, you can set color property such as `success`,`processing`,`error`,`default` and `warning` to indicate specific status.

examples.name: Draggable Tag
Custom semantic dom styling
examples.description: You can customize the semantic dom style of Tag by passing objects/functions through `classNames` and `styles`.
